name: Cloud Computing
summary: Building and running systems on public clouds: service models, compute, storage, networking, identity, serverless, cloud-native design and cost.

topics.name: Cloud concepts: elasticity, service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and deployment models
Cloud providers, regions and availability zones
Compute services: virtual machines and autoscaling
Cloud storage: object, block and file
Cloud networking: VPCs, load balancers and DNS
Serverless computing and functions as a service
Cloud-native design and the twelve-factor app
Cloud security and the shared-responsibility model
